name: Round dub sub
desc: A round, warm sine sub-bass walking an Eb-minor-pentatonic progression, felt more than heard. Gentle isaw pump on the eighths, a 32-cycle filter breath, and at peak a quiet triangle harmonic an octave up counter-sweeping in opposite phase. Dubby downtempo low-end.

code.full: note("<eb1 eb1 db2 <gb1 bb1>>").struct("x ~ x ~ x ~ x x").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(32)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).lastOf(8,x=>x.ply(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<eb1 eb1 db2 <gb1 bb1>>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.005).decay(.16).sustain(.4).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8,${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)), note("<eb2 gb2 db3 bb2>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ [x x]").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").decay(.14).sustain(.2).release(.06).lpf(cosine.range(${cut}*2,${cut}*4).slow(16)).gain(${gain}*.4).iter(4)).room(.12).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
